claim_scope: secondary discovery qualification of a task-wide executable knowledge ground on an already-exposed parent population

population.name: A2T-GROUND-QUAL-104
population.exposure: Identity-only selection from the already-exposed parent 400 after excluding every G1 and CPV2 query block. Parent A0 outcomes were not used. The separately protected unexposed 400 remains unopened.

M0_REGISTRY_DIRECT.input: original speech packet plus the unchanged complete 152-row registry instruction

G1_FULL_EXECUTABLE_GROUND.input: original speech packet plus the exact complete query-independent executable handbook
G1_FULL_EXECUTABLE_GROUND.purpose: test whether the frozen core can understand and use the full task knowledge

G1_RESEND_STABILITY.selection: before model contact, select two identities per tier by SHA-256 of the frozen namespace and sample id
G1_RESEND_STABILITY.request_equivalence: Reuse the exact source system/user message content, packet id/hash, decoding seed, temperature, max_tokens, and source id_slot. Only request/accounting identity is new.
G1_RESEND_STABILITY.purpose: measure semantic call stability without selecting on response or reward

execution_protocol.attempt_id_rule: Before start_session, write and hash one flight plan with attempt-{UTC flight stamp}-groundm0, attempt-{UTC flight stamp}-groundg1, and attempt-{UTC flight stamp}-groundresend. The three exact ids become immutable once that plan is written.
execution_protocol.failure_rule: On any partial phase failure, seal available trace/accounting, abort every still-OPENED attempt, stop the service, and end the mission. Never recontact a missing or failed row in this invocation. Any recovery requires a new prospective amendment.
execution_protocol.pre_score_verification: Require the M0 and G1 manifests to verify as complete OPENED 104-row bundles and require the 16-row resend trace/receipt to seal before stopping the service and opening gold.

resend_binding.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators comma/colon
resend_binding.precontact_rule: For every selected source, validate its sealed normalized payload and source id_slot, rebuild the intended resend from the same messages, packet binding and decoding, and require the intended normalized payload SHA-256 to equal the source hash before contact.
resend_binding.postcontact_rule: Require the actual traced resend normalized payload SHA-256 to equal the source hash. Only request/accounting identity may differ.

ground_gates.per_tier_primary_exact_floor: report only; no per-tier tuning or pass threshold
ground_gates.basic_ground_definition: At least 94/104 exact (90.38%), 99/104 tool-correct (95.19%), slot micro-F1 at least 0.90, and 103/104 parseable.
ground_gates.target_ground_definition: At least 99/104 exact (95.19%); reported as a stronger target, not substituted for the basic pass gate.

scoring.official_scorer: unchanged a2t-toolcall scorer, single-process per complete manifest
scoring.gold_open_rule: Both complete 104-row manifests and the 16-row resend trace must seal before either official scorer starts.
scoring.resend_read: After the two official jobs settle, use the unchanged local parser/item scorer only on the fixed 16 source/resend pairs.
scoring.score_artifact_rule: After each finalizer succeeds, re-run verify_bundle on the finalized manifest, require attempt state FINALIZED, and read only the manifest-bound scores artifact whose path and SHA-256 the verified bundle exposes.
scoring.empty_call_definition: parsed=true and the unchanged parser returns an empty call list; parse failures are reported separately and are not counted as parsed-empty calls.
scoring.ledger_cells: Write one complete human-ledger-cells JSON object per full arm before starting the two finalizers; the finalizer derives artifact hashes.

statistics.paired_outcome: ground exact-correct minus same-sample M0 exact-correct
statistics.replicate_rule: Sample the frozen query_block identities with replacement, include every paired row belonging to each sampled block, and compute the sample-weighted mean paired exact delta.

postscore_report.score_rows: Require exact equality between each finalized per_sample id set and the frozen 104 ids; derive parse/exact/tool counts from those rows and cross-check aggregate rates and slot micro totals.
postscore_report.resend_semantic_agreement: Both source and resend must parse, then call score_item with source parsed calls as expected and resend parsed calls as predicted; semantic agreement is exact_match==1. This inherits scorer-v1 canonical values, order-insensitive call multisets, and duplicate counts.
postscore_report.resend_parse_failure: Any resend parse failure fails that pair's semantic agreement and the resend parse-count gate.
postscore_report.resend_exact_outcome: Use the finalized G1 per_sample exact_match boolean for the source. After scorer completion opens gold, score the resend with the unchanged load_expected_calls plus score_item path and compare the two exact-match booleans.

terminal_rules.basic_pass: Freeze the full executable handbook as the qualified task ground. Only then design candidate reduction and AgentLoop information-acquisition experiments; training-free control remains a later distinct contribution.
terminal_rules.basic_fail: Do not prune candidates, fit training-free control, expand to approximately 1000, or tune on this cohort. Classify misses into observation, knowledge coverage, knowledge execution, value grounding, and output-format channels, then decide whether a separately preregistered expansion of knowledge construction is justified.
terminal_rules.target_pass: Record that the stronger 95% target is met; it does not by itself authorize scale.
